玩完了之后最大的感受就是既没有肉鸽buff叠起来的爽感也没有做好角色的技能，很多角色的专属buff极其鸡肋必须得拿很多个配套的buff才能用着还行。更抽象的是小怪和boss的设计，并不是一般肉鸽游戏的那种慢慢变难的设计，而是小怪一直是那个数值boss则是数值机制双起飞，有的boss机制垃圾打着和打小怪似的，有的又极其逆天，本来就只能带两个角色你还得分出一个行动去解决boss的机制，再加上角色行动是按位置来的也就是说你输出站前面那你一动要解boss的buff那你后面那个角色可能输出就不够了。 说了那么多，无非就是设计的有问题，这种难度设置和逆天的肉鸽buff设计使得这游戏玩的下去要么是厨子要么就是挑战极限的那一批玩家，一般的玩家只是想玩肉鸽游戏的我的建议是不要买。（作为厨力向游戏还是过关的）

异常情绪回收组 is an unconventional and highly experimental indie game that blends turn-based combat, roguelike structure, and RPG progression into a system-driven experience built around discovery and uncertainty. Developed and published by 墨元素, the game revolves around the concept of “abnormal emotions” as tangible entities—strange, rule-bound forces that must be studied, understood, and ultimately exploited. Rather than clearly explaining how these emotional entities behave, the game deliberately obscures their mechanics, forcing players to learn through experimentation, failure, and gradual insight. This design philosophy immediately sets the tone for an experience that values curiosity and pattern recognition over comfort or clarity. At the start of each run, players are thrust into encounters with emotion-based enemies whose effects are initially unknown. These emotions can trigger unexpected damage, buffs, debuffs, or conditional effects that may only reveal themselves after several interactions. Early battles often feel chaotic and even unfair, as a single misunderstood mechanic can abruptly end a run. However, this sense of danger is intentional. The game’s core loop is built around decoding these emotional rules, turning uncertainty into knowledge and knowledge into power. Once an emotion’s behavior is understood, it can be manipulated or combined with others to produce devastating synergies, transforming what was once a lethal threat into a strategic advantage. Combat unfolds in a turn-based format that emphasizes planning and adaptation rather than raw statistics. Every action carries weight, and the outcome of a battle often depends on how well the player understands the hidden logic governing enemy behavior. Unlike many traditional RPGs where enemy patterns are predictable and transparent, 异常情绪回收组 treats each encounter as a puzzle. Victory is less about grinding levels and more about applying insight gained from previous failures. This can make progression feel slow or punishing at first, but it also gives success a strong sense of earned mastery once systems begin to click. Character selection adds another layer of depth to the experience. The game features multiple playable characters, each with distinct mechanics that significantly alter how emotions are interacted with and how strategies are formed. These differences are not superficial; switching characters can fundamentally change how the same emotion behaves within combat, encouraging players to rethink established tactics. Combined with the wide variety of emotional entities and their potential interactions, this character diversity gives the game substantial replay value for those willing to invest the time to explore it fully. Visually, the game strikes an unusual balance between charm and unease. Anime-inspired character art sits alongside surreal and sometimes grotesque enemy designs, reinforcing the thematic contrast between approachable presentation and unsettling mechanics. The emotions themselves often look abstract or distorted, visually signaling that they do not follow conventional rules. The interface is functional but dense, reflecting the complexity of the underlying systems. While not always immediately readable, it improves as familiarity grows, mirroring the game’s broader emphasis on learning through repetition. The difficulty curve is one of the most divisive aspects of 异常情绪回收组. Sudden deaths caused by misunderstood mechanics are common, especially for new players, and the game offers limited hand-holding to ease the learning process. This can feel frustrating or opaque, particularly for players accustomed to more explanatory roguelikes. However, for those who enjoy deciphering complex systems and gradually building a mental model of how a game truly works, this difficulty becomes a defining strength rather than a flaw. Community reception reflects this split appeal. Players who enjoy deep mechanical experimentation and theorycrafting often praise the game for its originality and depth, while others criticize its lack of clarity and unforgiving early game. Language barriers can further complicate the experience for non-Chinese speakers, as nuanced mechanics are sometimes difficult to grasp without clear explanations. Even so, many players find that shared knowledge and discussion enhance the experience, turning the game into a collaborative puzzle beyond the screen itself. Overall, 异常情绪回收组 is a bold and demanding turn-based roguelike that prioritizes system discovery over accessibility. It is not designed to be immediately enjoyable or easily understood, but rather to reward persistence, curiosity, and analytical thinking. For players who enjoy unraveling opaque mechanics and transforming chaos into control, it offers a deeply satisfying journey filled with moments of genuine insight. While its niche design and steep learning curve will not appeal to everyone, it stands out as a rare example of a game willing to trust players to learn through failure and experimentation, making it a memorable experience for those willing to meet it on its own terms. Rating: 7/10

[i] 情绪，本应是生物独有的东西，但不知何时起，世间万物都拥有了情绪。 情绪产生了混乱……而某些过于强大的异常情绪，已经开始反过来扭曲事物的本质，如果就这样放任下去的话，将会产生极大的危害。 [/i] [h2] 游戏简介 [/h2] 《异常情绪回收组》是一款类rogue回合制战斗游戏。以两人小队的形式进行任务，一路上小队将遇到各式各样效果独特的情绪体，赌上【生命】为代价，将它们尽数回收吧！这些情绪体的特性也会随着探索的深入而逐步揭秘，加深对它们的了解程度，让它们为我所用、将其转变为情绪回收战斗中的强大助力！虽说在此之前还是暴毙的可能性更大一些啦…… 虽说是遇敌而被迫战斗，但实际上游戏的机制“怕什么来什么”（bushi）给了我们选择敌人的权力。通过【主观臆断】可以进行三选一的敌人选择，仅通过文字描述来选择敌人还是非常有趣的，尤其是初次游玩时新鲜感非常足。击败敌人可以获得情绪能量和情绪碎片（可以用来购物的货币）。值得注意的是战斗完成后有可能遭到不妙的“诅咒”，真是恶趣味啊（谴责.jpg） 战后会出现【人格塑造】环节，而塔罗牌、个性化与情绪体则分别对应着小队通用效果与单个角色强化，情绪体则是有特定使用规则的强大“双刃剑”，务必小心收容。真理律能在图鉴中可以用来解析情绪体，从而加深对其的了解程度——毕竟芝士就是力量！ 就像《脑叶公司》收容怪物那样，在掌握情绪体的特性之前，我们只能如履薄冰地进行观察，也很有可能在有成效前就死于非命……反正我是被淹死了orz 总体而言，《异常情绪回收组》是一部非常独特……且恶趣味的作品（才没有）推荐给勇于接受挑战和失败的抖M玩家～ [quote] 奏游戏之乐章，品人生之绚烂 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45672460/]欢迎加入 『 丰川集团 』[/url] [u][b]以丰川集团之名，行评测鉴赏之事[/b][/u][/quote]

画风很独特的一款回合制肉鸽卡牌策略游戏。 在本作的世界观里，世间的万物都滋生出了专属情绪，这些情绪具象化为诡异，肆意扰乱着世界秩序；部分强大的异常情绪甚至拥有扭曲事物本质的恐怖能力，它们严重威胁着人类社会的安稳。为了遏制这些失控的诡异存在，专门的组织“异常情绪回收组”应运而生。而玩家将扮演其中的组织成员，肩负起回收异常情绪、消灭诡物的使命，踏入一个个充满未知的危险区域，在一次次冒险中，揭开异常情绪背后的秘密。 游戏玩法还是经典的回合制战斗，不过其还融合了肉鸽玩法，玩家可从八名回收组成员中，自由选择两人组队出战，不断向前调查推进流程，途中会遭遇各类异常诡物、随机事件，最终挑战终极BOSS，成功击败BOSS便完成一轮冒险。作为肉鸽游戏，每一场战斗胜利后，玩家都会获得一次强化自身的机会，从塔罗牌、个性化、情绪体三类人格中三选一：塔罗牌属于全队通用的被动加成；个性化是针对单一角色的定向强化，能够解锁角色专属新技能；情绪体则是游戏最具特色的养成道具，战力极强但伴随严苛规则与巨大副作用。 同时，在推进流程的过程中，玩家还能随机进入八个不同的画中世界，其中有回血补给、商店购物、随机事件等多种内容，能有效缓解冒险中的生存压力。除此之外，作为肉鸽，局外养成机制自然不会少，玩家可以在主界面通过情绪解放功能，消耗情绪能量对角色进行永久强化。 总的来说，《异常情绪回收组》没有浪费本作优质的怪谈题材，将规则、未知、诡异很好地融入了回合制的肉鸽玩法中，带来了新鲜且上头的游玩体验。如果是喜欢类似题材的玩家值得一玩。 [quote] 奏游戏之乐章，品人生之绚烂 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45672460/]欢迎加入 『 丰川集团 』[/url] [u][b]以丰川集团之名，行评测鉴赏之事[/b][/u][/quote]
